## 📍 eBay Location Check Proxy (READ-ONLY)

Serves the **Location Update** sheet's "⇊ Fetch eBay Locations" sidebar button. Receives `{ items: [{sku, itemId}] }` from Apps Script, calls Trading API **GetItem** per item, extracts the **"Model Year"** item specific (= the physical location field this business uses on eBay), and responds **synchronously** with `{ ok, count, results: [{sku, itemId, ok, location, error}] }` so the sheet can paint match/mismatch verdicts instantly.

**Read-only** — GetItem only. Cannot write anything to eBay.

**Quota:** shared Trading API pool (5,000/day). One GetItem per unique SKU per button press — a 50-row sheet costs 1% of the pool.

**Setup on import (2 steps):**
1. Bind the existing **Header Auth account** credential on the Webhook node (X-API-Token = APP_SECRET_TOKEN).
2. Open **🔑 Get eBay Access Token** and replace the two `<<PASTE...>>` placeholders with the SAME values used in MAIN → "1. Get Access Token" (the Basic authorization header value, and the refresh_token in the body). Or simply copy that node from MAIN and rewire it in place of this one.

Then **activate**. Webhook path `ebay-location-check` must stay as-is (matches N8N_EBAY_LOCATION_WEBHOOK_URL in Secrets.js).
